title: Late Lights
description:
Late Nights is a mod that adds new music, themed after the feelings of longing and nostalgia. Perfect to have playing in the background when you're building, crafting, or even in your SMP's town square.
We hope you enjoy!
body:
Late Nights is a simple mod that brings the feelings of longing and nostalgia to minecraft with new music.

Music by Ezo-0. Produced by hifiddeliti.
Do not redistribute our music.

## Songs:
- Outlook
- Fleeting
